mapper.select: SELECT wi.id, wi.key, wi.title, wi.common_status, wi.flagged, wi.block_reason, wi.assignee_id, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - wi.status_changed_at)) / 86400)::bigint AS age_days FROM work_items wi WHERE wi.project_id = #{projectId} AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.common_status NOT IN ('DONE', 'HOLD') AND ( wi.flagged = true OR wi.status_changed_at < now() - ((#{sleDays} * 0.8) || ' day')::interval ) ORDER BY wi.flagged DESC, age_days DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT count(*) FROM work_items WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND flagged = true

SELECT count(*) FROM work_items wi WHERE wi.project_id = #{projectId} AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.common_status NOT IN ('DONE', 'HOLD') AND wi.status_changed_at < now() - (#{sleDays} || ' day')::interval

SELECT count(DISTINCT al.work_item_id) FROM activity_logs al JOIN work_items wi ON wi.id = al.work_item_id AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.project_id = #{projectId} JOIN workflow_status ws ON ws.code = al.to_value WHERE al.action = 'STATUS_CHANGE' AND ws.common_status = 'DONE'

SELECT wi.id, wi.key, wi.title, wi.assignee_id, count(*) AS reopen_count FROM activity_logs al JOIN work_items wi ON wi.id = al.work_item_id AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.project_id = #{projectId} JOIN workflow_status wf_from ON wf_from.code = al.from_value JOIN workflow_status wf_to ON wf_to.code = al.to_value WHERE al.action = 'STATUS_CHANGE' AND wf_from.common_status = 'DONE' AND wf_to.common_status <> 'DONE' GROUP BY wi.id, wi.key, wi.title, wi.assignee_id ORDER BY reopen_count DESC, wi.id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT count(DISTINCT al.work_item_id) FROM activity_logs al JOIN work_items wi ON wi.id = al.work_item_id AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.project_id = #{projectId} JOIN workflow_status wf_from ON wf_from.code = al.from_value JOIN workflow_status wf_to ON wf_to.code = al.to_value WHERE al.action = 'STATUS_CHANGE' AND wf_from.common_status = 'DONE' AND wf_to.common_status <> 'DONE'

SELECT wi.assignee_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE wi.common_status NOT IN ('DONE','HOLD')) AS in_progress, count(*) FILTER (WHERE wi.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND wi.common_status NOT IN ('DONE','HOLD')) AS delayed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE wi.flagged = true) AS blocked FROM work_items wi WHERE wi.project_id = #{projectId} AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND wi.common_status <> 'DONE' GROUP BY wi.assignee_id HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE wi.common_status NOT IN ('DONE','HOLD')) > 0 ORDER BY blocked DESC, delayed DESC, in_progress DESC
